mana_awakened.codex.title: Cultivator's Codex
mana_awakened.codex.cultivation.1: You carry a mana core. Meditate (K) to absorb mana from the air. When the core is full it trains and grows; once it has reached its threshold and is full you may break through (hold B) to the next Circle. There are ten Circles, and from the 6th on the heavens test you with a trial.
mana_awakened.codex.cultivation.2: On bare ground the core grows slowly, on purpose. Three things speed it up: a Meditation Circle under you, mana-rich land around you, and refinements, rare materials your body absorbs once.
mana_awakened.codex.meditation.1: Build a Meditation Core and lay Rune Plates flat around it, level with the core, in complete square rings: ring 1 is 3x3, ring 2 is 5x5, up to ring 5 at 11x11. The tier of a circle is the number of complete rings.
mana_awakened.codex.meditation.2: Meditate anywhere over the finished area: core growth is multiplied by the factor of the tier, and you absorb mana faster too. Right-click the core to read its tier. A circle is how you reach the high Circles.
mana_awakened.codex.ambient.1: The air holds mana in different amounts, shown beside your core on the HUD. Above 1.0 everything improves: core growth, absorption and the growth of crops, saplings and modded seeds (Mystical Agriculture included).
mana_awakened.codex.ambient.2: Leylines are broad hidden rivers of mana in the overworld: walk and watch the readout. Cherry groves, meadows, flower forests, lush caves and mountains hold more. Mushroom fields, the deep dark and the End hold the most.
mana_awakened.codex.ambient.3: A Mana Condenser burns Forge Energy (FE) from any cable or generator and fills the air around it with mana. Place several to make a training ground anywhere. The field fades toward its edge, and the total is capped.
mana_awakened.codex.refinements.1: Refinements are permanent upgrades from rare materials. Meditate, crouch and hold the material in your main hand until the ritual completes. Each one can be absorbed once. They add core growth, health, armor and purity points (the nine together are worth 100 purity).
mana_awakened.codex.refinements.2: Below: every material, what it gives and where to get it. The same lines appear in the item tooltips.
mana_awakened.codex.source.warden_meridi: Where: dropped by a slain Warden.
mana_awakened.codex.source.star_core: Where: a Nether Star, dropped by the Wither.
mana_awakened.codex.source.abyssal_eye: Where: dropped by a slain Elder Guardian.
mana_awakened.codex.source.netherite_ski: Where: a Netherite Ingot (Ancient Debris smelted, combined with gold).
mana_awakened.codex.source.golden_marrow: Where: an Enchanted Golden Apple, found only in rare loot chests.
mana_awakened.codex.source.undying_will: Where: a Totem of Undying, dropped by Evokers.
mana_awakened.codex.source.shulker_carap: Where: a Shulker Shell, dropped by Shulkers in End Cities.
mana_awakened.codex.source.echo_insight: Where: an Echo Shard, found in Ancient City chests.
mana_awakened.codex.source.tidal_heart: Where: a Heart of the Sea, found in buried treasure.
mana_awakened.codex.source.dragon_heart: Where: dropped by the Ender Dragon. Reforges your whole vessel: hold it and meditate. Needed for the 7th Circle and beyond.
mana_awakened.codex.trials.1: Craft an Inscription Altar and open it. In the Trials tab choose a sigil and solve its Ring of Wisdom: set the glyphs on the ring so that every clue holds. Click a glyph, then a slot. Slots count clockwise from the top. Clues that your arrangement already breaks turn red.
mana_awakened.codex.trials.2: Every puzzle has exactly one answer and every clue is needed, so reasoning always works and guessing never does. Greater sigils have bigger rings and need a higher Circle. A wrong answer gives you a fresh ring after a short pause.
mana_awakened.codex.sigil.line: Circle %s, ring of %s, base cost %s mana
mana_awakened.codex.spells.1: Every unlocked sigil can become any number of spells. In the Workshop tab, give a spell levels of modifiers with no fixed limit: every level raises the mana price, except Efficiency, which lowers it (never below 35%).
mana_awakened.codex.spells.2: Spell power grows strongly with your Circle while the price grows only mildly, so a spell is far better at a higher Circle. Hold the Spell Wheel key (N) and release over a spell to select it, then press Cast (U). Next/previous spell: ] / [. The targets of a working spell can be changed anywhere with the quick target menu (J). All keys can be rebound.
mana_awakened.codex.spells.3: The levels are unlimited, but the engine caps effects that multiply a loop: beams 24, pierce 32, chain 16, echoes 8, radius 16 blocks. A modifier works only once your Circle has reached its minimum.
mana_awakened.codex.modifier.line: Needs Circle %s, +%s%% mana cost per level
mana_awakened.codex.passives.1: Every Circle has five passive skills. Craft a Passive Scroll (recipes below), right-click it to learn the passive, then open the Passives screen (O) and choose one per Circle. Only chosen passives of Circles you have reached are active.
mana_awakened.codex.passives.2: A scroll is shapeless: Paper, the passive's own ingredient and a catalyst that depends on the Circle. Amethyst Shard (Circles 1-2), Diamond (3-4), Eye of Ender (5-6), Block of Diamond (7-8), Dragon's Breath (9-10).

mana_awakened.codex.block.rune_plate.rec: 8 Stone Bricks around an Amethyst Shard makes 8.
mana_awakened.codex.block.meditation_cor: The heart of a Meditation Circle.
Diamond in the centre, Amethyst Shards on the edges, Rune Plates in the corners.

mana_awakened.codex.cultivation.3: Leaving a Circle needs a core of a set size, its threshold (500 in the first, 2,500 in the second, 12,500 in the third: five times more each Circle), and the breakthrough doubles the core you trained. Past the threshold the core trains ever slower up to its ceiling: twice the threshold if every Circle behind you was trained full, less otherwise, but never less than 1.1 times the threshold. How full you leave a Circle (the share of the way from its threshold to its ceiling) shapes all the later ones, with a higher ceiling and a faster base rate. Leaving at the ceiling itself is a perfect clear: it lets you choose two passives of that Circle and adds 5 purity for good.

mana_awakened.codex.cultivation.4: Purity (0 to 150) is a trait of your body, not something you gather. Only two things raise it: refinements (the nine together give 100 points) and perfect clears (5 points for every Circle you leave at its ceiling). Meditating, absorbing mana, casting, dying or breaking through never change it. Every breakthrough starts from a 100% chance, lowered by body heat above 50% and by every Circle you already hold; purity adds up to +50% that makes up for them. It also raises spell damage (up to ×1.30), mana absorption (×1.30) and core growth (×1.50).

sigil.mana_awakened.mana_bolt.desc: A bolt of pure mana that strikes the first foe in your sight.
sigil.mana_awakened.ember.desc: A lance of fire that burns what it hits. With "environment" switched on it can start fires and melt snow and ice; a great fire fuses sand and stone into glass and magma and opens a pool of lava at its heart.
sigil.mana_awakened.ward.desc: Wraps you in a shell of absorption.
sigil.mana_awakened.restore.desc: Mends you and nearby allies and cleanses poison.
sigil.mana_awakened.frost.desc: A lance of ice that chills and slows. With "environment" switched on it can freeze water and lay snow; in great cold the ground itself turns to packed and blue ice and lava to obsidian.
sigil.mana_awakened.storm.desc: Calls lightning down on the foe you look at. With "environment" switched on it can call real lightning that fuses sand to glass and can set things alight; from the third Circle it brings a real thunderstorm.
sigil.mana_awakened.blink.desc: Step through the mana currents to where you look.
sigil.mana_awakened.nova.desc: Hurls a star of mana that bursts where it lands, or at the end of its flight.
sigil.mana_awakened.meteor.desc: Drops a meteor on the spot you look at. With "environment" switched on it can start fires and melt snow and ice; a great fire fuses sand and stone into glass and magma and opens a pool of lava at its heart.
sigil.mana_awakened.spark.desc: A beam of lightning that strikes everything along its line. It stuns foes for a moment. With "environment" switched on it can call real lightning that fuses sand to glass and can set things alight; from the third Circle it brings a real thunderstorm.
sigil.mana_awakened.stone_shard.desc: Launches a volley of earth that seeks the foes in front of you. It slows foes and heaves them upward. With "environment" switched on it can crack stone, heave up spears and mounds of rock that crumble again, and break loose soil, sand and leaves.
sigil.mana_awakened.gust.desc: A shockwave of wind rolls forward along the ground. It flings foes into the air. With "environment" switched on it can blow away plants, snow and fires and strip the leaves from the trees.
sigil.mana_awakened.vine_lash.desc: A shockwave of nature rolls forward along the ground. It poisons foes. With "environment" switched on it can green the bare ground, make plants and crops grow and raise saplings into trees (its curses wither it all).
sigil.mana_awakened.splash.desc: A cone of water sweeps the ground in front of you. It soaks foes, slows them and puts out fire. With "environment" switched on it can put out fires, quench lava into obsidian, water farmland and flood the land for a while; from the fourth Circle it brings rain.
sigil.mana_awakened.shadow_dart.desc: Launches a volley of shadow that seeks the foes in front of you. It withers and weakens foes.
sigil.mana_awakened.swift_step.desc: Fills you and nearby allies with the power of wind. With "environment" switched on it can blow away plants, snow and fires and strip the leaves from the trees.
sigil.mana_awakened.flame_breath.desc: A cone of fire sweeps the ground in front of you. It sets foes alight. With "environment" switched on it can start fires and melt snow and ice; a great fire fuses sand and stone into glass and magma and opens a pool of lava at its heart.
sigil.mana_awakened.thunderclap.desc: Hurls a ball of lightning that explodes where it lands, or at the end of its flight. It stuns foes for a moment. With "environment" switched on it can call real lightning that fuses sand to glass and can set things alight; from the third Circle it brings a real thunderstorm.
sigil.mana_awakened.stone_spike.desc: A column of earth erupts where you look and hurls foes upward. It slows foes and heaves them upward. With "environment" switched on it can crack stone, heave up spears and mounds of rock that crumble again, and break loose soil, sand and leaves.

sigil.mana_awakened.celestial_meteor.des: Drops a meteor of arcane on the spot you look at.
sigil.mana_awakened.time_dilation.desc: A lingering whirl of arcane that drags in and wears down everything inside.
sigil.mana_awakened.transcendent_step.de: Step through a rift of light to where you look.
sigil.mana_awakened.primordial_might.des: Fills you and nearby allies with the power of arcane.
sigil.mana_awakened.wrath_of_heaven.desc: Calls a bolt of light down on the spot you look at. It scorches the undead and makes foes glow.
sigil.mana_awakened.wayfinder.desc: A spirit of wind runs ahead along the ground toward the place you choose (the world spawn, your bed or where you last died) and tells you the bearing.
sigil.mana_awakened.magnet.desc: Everything that lies about - items and orbs of experience - is pulled to you in a stream of mana.
sigil.mana_awakened.wisp_light.desc: Wisps fly from your hand to the darkest places around and settle there, glowing, so nothing can spawn in the dark any more. They fade after a while.
sigil.mana_awakened.forge_touch.desc: Smelts what you hold, or every smeltable item lying about, in a breath of fire: ore to ingots, sand to glass, raw meat to meals. You keep the experience.
sigil.mana_awakened.harvest.desc: Every ripe crop around you is reaped in a wave of green light and sown again, so the field keeps growing.
sigil.mana_awakened.ore_sense.desc: A pulse runs through the ground and the ore of the kind you choose within reach glows through the rock for a while.
sigil.mana_awakened.earthbreaker.desc: Breaks the block you look at, and its neighbours, like a perfect pickaxe; the drops fly to you. Choose plain, silk touch, fortune or shatter (a great blast that leaves no drops).
sigil.mana_awakened.lumberjack.desc: Fells the whole tree you look at in one swing, branches and all, and the logs come to you. It can plant a sapling in its place.
sigil.mana_awakened.anchor_set.desc: Leaves one of three anchors where you stand. It remembers the place and the world; Recall Anchor brings you back to it.
sigil.mana_awakened.homeward.desc: Stand still for a few seconds while the world folds around you, and be carried to your bed, to the world spawn or to the place you last died. Moving or being hurt breaks the spell.
sigil.mana_awakened.anchor_return.desc: Tears the space open and returns you to one of your three anchors, in whichever world it lies.
sigil.mana_awakened.ice_path.desc: A wave of cold runs ahead of you: water turns to ice and lava to obsidian, a path across the lake. After a while it thaws again.
sigil.mana_awakened.hissing_charge.desc: A charge flies to where you look, lies there hissing, swells and flashes like a creeper - and bursts. Foes are hurt and flung back; with destruction switched on it blasts a crater.
sigil.mana_awakened.tunnel_bore.desc: A drill of mana bores a straight tunnel ahead of you, narrow or wide, and the ore comes along. It stops before water or lava.
sigil.mana_awakened.rampart.desc: A battlemented wall of stone bricks grows out of the ground in front of you, from its middle outward. It crumbles again after a while.
sigil.mana_awakened.spring.desc: A geyser breaks out of the ground where you look and leaves a spring of clean water. It waters the fields, puts out fires and soothes whoever stands in it.
sigil.mana_awakened.updraft.desc: A column of rising air lifts everything in it for some seconds. Players are held up gently, so the way down is soft.
sigil.mana_awakened.seer_sight.desc: Opens the eye of a seer: the creatures of the kind you choose glow through walls and rock for a while.
sigil.mana_awakened.vein_reaver.desc: Tears out the whole vein of ore you look at, block by block, following it through the rock. The ore comes to you.
sigil.mana_awakened.starlight_bridge.des: A bridge of glowing glass is laid out ahead of you over the gaps, a row at a time, and fades from behind. Starlight also holds you up should it fade under your feet.
sigil.mana_awakened.structure_compass.de: Finds the nearest structure of the kind you choose - a village, a mansion, a stronghold, a fortress... - and keeps pointing the way to it for a while.
sigil.mana_awakened.weather_weave.desc: The clouds gather and rain falls, or they are blown apart and the sun comes out. It changes the weather of the whole world.
sigil.mana_awakened.shadow_veil.desc: You melt into shadow: invisible, and every creature that hunts you loses the trail - again and again while the veil lasts.
sigil.mana_awakened.chrono_step.desc: Steps back through the last seconds of time: you return to where you stood a moment ago, with the health you had then.
sigil.mana_awakened.terraform.desc: Cuts the hills down and fills the hollows up to the level of your feet, in a wide circle, and lays the natural ground back on top. The stone you cut away comes to you.
sigil.mana_awakened.rift_walk.desc: Finds the nearest structure of the kind you choose and steps through a rift straight to it, in the world you stand in.
sigil.mana_awakened.dayspring.desc: The sun races across the sky to the dawn or to high noon. It changes the time of the whole world.
sigil.mana_awakened.nightfall.desc: The sky darkens and the stars fall into place: the clock runs on to the sunset or to midnight. It changes the time of the whole world.
sigil.mana_awakened.volcano.desc: A volcano heaves out of the ground where you look, with a crater of magma at its top. It erupts: smoke, sparks and burning bombs fall on your enemies. Later the mountain sinks again.
sigil.mana_awakened.rewind.desc: The clock turns back around you: blocks that spells and explosions tore out or changed in the last minute return to their places - a creeper crater closes, a burnt field is green again.
sigil.mana_awakened.summon_tempest.desc: A real thunderstorm breaks over you. For some seconds lightning falls on your enemies - and on the land around. It changes the weather of the whole world.
sigil.mana_awakened.second_life.desc: For a while, the next blow that would kill you does not: you are left standing, half healed, and the ward is spent.
sigil.mana_awakened.eternal_winter.desc: Winter falls on the land around you: lakes freeze, snow settles and the ground turns to ice, and a blizzard slows and freezes your enemies. The Rewind rite can set the land back.
sigil.mana_awakened.dimension_gate.desc: Opens a shimmering gate where you look. Whoever steps through arrives in the world you chose, at the matching place. It closes after a while.
